note: パートナーシップ and công ty hợp danh both describe a business association of partners; the Vietnamese term is the established legal form for this sense.
蜜 and mật can mean honey generally. 花蜜 means nectar in JMdict (ent_seq 1975420 sense 0), and mật hoa specifies the flower liquid in Vietnamese.
偶然 usually means chance or coincidence. 偶然性 names contingency as the quality of happening by chance in JMdict (ent_seq 2849513 sense 0).
返す usually means return or pay back. 交換する expresses exchanging things, with the base noun 交換 glossed as exchange and reciprocity in JMdict (ent_seq 1271750 sense 0).
角 and sừng directly mean the growth on an animal's head described as a horn; the shared horn or antler range does not conflict with this definition.
局所 is a general technical word for local. ローカル is the common programming adjective, glossed as local in JMdict (ent_seq 1146300 sense 0).
突っ立つ specifically suggests standing around idly. 静止 means being stationary or standing still in JMdict (ent_seq 1381870 sense 0), matching remaining motionless more neutrally.
Phó chủ tịch can refer to vice chairs or deputies in many organizations. Phó tổng thống specifically names a country's vice president, matching 副大統領 and the stated succession role.
針 and ngòi both have a stinger sense for the pointed insect part used to attack; the insect context disambiguates their other meanings.
Hóa đơn is a general bill or invoice. Hóa đơn thương mại specifies the seller-to-buyer document listing goods, quantities, and prices.
揚げる directly means deep-fry, and chiên rán ngập mỡ is a clear descriptive Vietnamese equivalent even though it uses several words.
Sinh nhật means a birthday itself. Tiệc sinh nhật specifies the party held to celebrate it.
稿 means a manuscript, version, or draft and nháp is a natural Vietnamese word for a preliminary written work.
母斑 is the technical Japanese term for birthmark, and bớt is the common Vietnamese equivalent for a mark formed before birth.
詰まる has a direct sense of becoming shorter, shrinking, or narrowing, matching the supplied English definition.
出入り is directly glossed as increase and decrease, surplus and deficit, and fluctuation, matching the supplied entry sense.
臣民 and thần dân both mean a citizen or subject under a monarch; the Japanese word is archaic but exact for this political sense.
広める often means spread or popularize. 広げる has the direct scope-broadening sense in JMdict (ent_seq 1602370 sense 0).
寂しい can mean desolate or forlorn as well as lonely, and fits the stated emotional sense of sadness and hopelessness.
Biểu tượng means a symbol generally. Biểu tượng trên máy tính specifies the small picture used as a computer icon.
Phóng viên is a reporter generally. Phóng viên thường trú conveys a correspondent reporting from a distant or overseas post.
調べる is the ordinary Japanese verb for obtaining information from a book or other reference, even though it also has broader investigation senses.
画く is a less common spelling of the verb. 描く is the standard spelling and is glossed as draw, paint, and sketch in JMdict (ent_seq 1583460 sense 0).
Bông commonly refers to cotton fiber. Cây bông specifies the Gossypium plant that produces the fiber.
しっかり has a direct reliably or dependably sense in JMdict, which matches the English adverb in this entry.
乗 is the conventional Japanese mathematical term in expressions such as xのn乗 for the nth power, matching the defined product of equal factors.
腹黒い implies a scheming or black-hearted disposition. 意地悪 means mean, malicious, or unkind in JMdict (ent_seq 1156740 sense 0) and better fits the general ill-will definition.
こと can introduce an alias only in a larger construction. 別名 means another name or alias in JMdict (ent_seq 1583930 senses 0-1) and is the general Japanese equivalent.
傷付ける can suggest a physical scratch or wound. 損なう means harm, damage, spoil, or mar in JMdict (ent_seq 1596510 sense 0), covering soundness, goodness, or value.
頭状花 means a flower head specifically, while the English definition also covers clumps of seeds or leaves; this Japanese term covers only part of the listed sense.
白球 means a white ball generally. 手球 specifically means cue ball in JMdict (ent_seq 2831905 sense 0).
もろい directly means fragile, brittle, or weak, and dễ vỡ is the common Vietnamese equivalent for readily breakable or disrupted.
書誌 is a precise though technical word for a bibliography, and thư mục is a valid Vietnamese term for a list of works on a subject.
要塞 means fort or stronghold, and pháo đài is the ordinary Vietnamese term for a fortified defensive structure occupied by troops.
サーベイランス is a direct loanword but less common in general Japanese. 監視 is the usual word for surveillance and is glossed that way in JMdict (ent_seq 1213680 sense 0).
嫌疑 is specifically criminal or legal suspicion. 疑い is the general Japanese noun for suspicion in JMdict (ent_seq 1225490 sense 0), matching the broader English definition.
年金 and niên kim both refer to regular payments over a period or a recipient's lifetime, as defined for this annuity sense.
胆汁 is bile, and Vietnamese mật also names the digestive secretion produced by the liver; the fluid definition disambiguates it from the gallbladder.
かたつむり usually means a land snail. 巻貝 covers snails or spiral-shelled gastropods more generally in JMdict (ent_seq 1603860 sense 0).
汎化 is the technical term for generalization from specific cases, and khái quát hoá expresses forming a general concept by abstraction.
